result.topic_en: Bare numerical calculation, apparently with logarithms, for the number 5.048 = 631/125: a subtraction followed by a column of partial products and their sum; a mirrored show-through from the other side cites Laplace's Théorie analytique des probabilités, 3rd ed., Paris 1820.

methods.what: Expressing a decimal number as an exact fraction
Subtraction of two numbers, possibly logarithms of numerator and denominator, to obtain the logarithm of the quotient
Long multiplication by summing a column of partial products
